description.p: Soplos AppImage Manager integrates AppImage applications into the Soplos Linux desktop. It moves AppImages to ~/AppImages/, extracts their icon and metadata, creates menu entries for them, and checks GitHub, GitLab and Codeberg for updates.

description.p: First beta of Soplos AppImage Manager 3.0. Detects already-installed AppImages instead of creating duplicates, shows errors in a visible dialog, and fixes a memory exhaustion bug in metadata extraction along with several process-isolation issues when launching AppImages.

ul.li: Fixed downloading an update failing on any AppImage larger than 10MB

description.p: Full architecture rewrite of Soplos AppImage Manager, from Python 3 and GTK3 to Tauri 2 with a Rust backend and a Svelte frontend.
